standard: near-contract-standards 5.29.0: FungibleToken (NEP-141 core) + StorageManagement (NEP-145), as exposed by the near-sdk-rs fungible-token example (tag near-sdk-v5.29.0)

properties.title: Conservation
properties.text: In every reachable state, total_supply equals the sum of all account balances.

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P1_conservation
theorems.statement: theorem P1_conservation {E : Env} {S : Sys} (h : Reach E S) : S.c.supply = total S.c.accts

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P1_inv_step
theorems.statement: theorem P1_inv_step (E : Env) {S : Sys} (hI : Inv E S) (st : Step) : Inv E (sysStep E S st)

properties.title: transfer_call settlement
properties.text: When the settlement callback of an ft_transfer_call of `amount` from a sender to a receiver runs, whatever the receiver's ft_on_transfer did (returned any number, unparsable bytes, a value longer than 42 bytes, or failed), the refund to the sender is at most `amount` and at most what the receiver still holds; the receiver loses exactly the refund and no other account changes; if the sender is still registered, the sender gains exactly the refund, so the sender + receiver total and the supply are conserved; if the sender has unregistered, the refund is burned. In a reachable state the callback cannot fail for arithmetic reasons.

theorems.statement: theorem P2_settlement_never_fails (E : Env) (hE : E.Sane) (S : Sys) (hI : Inv E S) (sn rc : Acct) (amt : Nat) (res : PR) : ∃ o, exec E S.c ⟨E.self, 0, .ft_resolve_transfer sn rc amt, [res]⟩ = some o

properties.title: Callback ownership
properties.text: ft_resolve_transfer takes effect only as the token's own settlement callback: called by any other account, by another contract, as another contract's callback with promise results of its choice, or by a transaction signed with the token account's own key, it fails and changes nothing.

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P3_callback_private
theorems.statement: theorem P3_callback_private (E : Env) (s : St) (p : Acct) (hp : p ≠ E.self) (d : Nat) (sn rc : Acct) (amt : Nat) (rs : List PR) : method E s ⟨p, d, .ft_resolve_transfer sn rc amt, rs⟩ = none

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P3_callback_private_sys
theorems.statement: theorem P3_callback_private_sys (E : Env) (S : Sys) (p : Acct) (d : Nat) (sn rc : Acct) (amt : Nat) (rs : List PR) : sysStep E S (.call p d (.ft_resolve_transfer sn rc amt) rs) = S

properties.title: Balance ownership
properties.text: No step other than a call by the holder lowers the holder's balance, except the settlement of an ft_transfer_call made to that holder, which takes back at most the amount of that transfer. The holder's own calls that can lower it are exactly ft_transfer, ft_transfer_call and storage_unregister(force = true); a settlement in flight exists only for a transfer that credited the holder exactly that amount.

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P4_balance_ownership
theorems.statement: theorem P4_balance_ownership (E : Env) (S : Sys) (u : Acct) (st : Step) (hst : ∀ d m rs, st ≠ .call u d m rs) : bal S.c.accts u ≤ bal (sysStep E S st).c.accts u ∨ ∃ i res sn amt, st = .resolve i res ∧ S.pending[i]? = some (sn, u, amt) ∧ bal S.c.accts u ≤ bal (sysStep E S st).c.accts u + amt

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P4_who_can_lower
theorems.statement: theorem P4_who_can_lower (E : Env) (S : Sys) (u : Acct) (st : Step) (hlt : bal (sysStep E S st).c.accts u < bal S.c.accts u) : (∃ d rc x memo rs, st = .call u d (.ft_transfer rc x memo) rs) ∨ (∃ d rc x memo msg rs, st = .call u d (.ft_transfer_call rc x memo msg) rs) ∨ (∃ d rs, st = .call u d (.storage_unregister (some true)) rs) ∨ (∃ i res sn amt, st = .resolve i res ∧ S.pending[i]? = some (sn, u, amt))

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P4_pending_origin
theorems.statement: theorem P4_pending_origin (E : Env) (S : Sys) (st : Step) (e : Acct × Acct × Nat) (he : e ∈ (sysStep E S st).pending) (hnew : e ∉ S.pending) : ∃ p d rc x memo msg rs, st = .call p d (.ft_transfer_call rc x memo msg) rs ∧ e = (p, rc, x) ∧ p ≠ rc ∧ 0 < x ∧ bal (sysStep E S st).c.accts rc = bal S.c.accts rc + x ∧ bal (sysStep E S st).c.accts p + x = bal S.c.accts p

properties.title: Storage
properties.text: storage_unregister with 1 yoctoNEAR: with force = true it removes the caller's account and burns its whole balance (total_supply drops by exactly that balance) and pays the caller the storage minimum plus 1 yoctoNEAR; with a zero balance it does the same with or without force and burns nothing; without force and with a positive balance it fails and changes nothing; for an unregistered caller it changes nothing and returns false. storage_deposit registers an account for exactly the storage minimum and refunds the rest to the caller. In every reachable state the token holds enough NEAR for its base storage plus one storage refund per registered account.

theorems.name: ProvedFT.P5_storage_solvent
theorems.statement: theorem P5_storage_solvent (E : Env) (hE : E.Sane) {S : Sys} (h : Reach E S) : S.c.accts.length * E.minBal + E.base ≤ S.c.near ∧ E.base + stor E.entry S.c.accts ≤ S.c.near
